changes.title: Social Security beneficiaries by state first published
changes.summary: SSA counts and monthly amounts of Social Security (OASDI) beneficiaries by type of benefit for the nation, 50 states, DC and five territories, December 2025: 70,451,490 beneficiaries, 53,624,664 retired workers and 7,125,880 disabled workers; the average across all beneficiaries was $1,923 a month.
